objects.name: Detection technique coverage: unloading-amsi-via-reflection
objects.description: The following analytic detects the tampering of AMSI (Antimalware Scan Interface) via PowerShell reflection. It leverages PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventCode=4104) to capture and analyze suspicious PowerShell commands, specifically those involving `system.management.automation.amsi`. This activity is significant as it indicates an attempt to bypass AMSI, a critical security feature that helps detect and block malicious scripts.
